message.content:
Decorative copper wall plaques would most likely fall in heading 7419 (other articles of copper). Other options are 8306 (statuettes and other ornaments of base metal) and 9703 (original sculptures). Heading 8306 covers "bells, gongs and the like, non-electric; statuettes and other ornaments; photograph, picture or similar frames; mirrors." Subheading 8306.29 covers other statuettes and ornaments, and 8306.30 covers frames and mirrors. Wall plaques are generally treated as ornaments of base metal, so 8306 seems likely. Note 3 to Section XV and the 8306 text suggest ornaments of base metal go there, and 8306.29.00 splits into plated with precious metal (8306.21) and other (8306.29.00). The statistical suffix for 8306.29.00 is 8306.29.0000.

Heading 7419 covers other articles of copper, but Chapter 74 does not exclude 8306 items, and 8306 is the more specific heading for ornaments. CBP rulings on hand-hammered copper wall plaques have classified them in 8306.29.0000, HTSUS, as "Other statuettes and other ornaments: Other."

Their construction as relief sheet copper on a backing is consistent with this view.
